title: 1.4S, 86.2W - Tumerok Towers
summary: Two Tumerok spire towers (0x01001117, 31 m) side by side on a barren ridge plateau (z 150) in the far west of the Dires, close to the Obsidian Rim Portal (Points of Interest Map no. 31). The ridge falls 30-50 m to the north and west. The Heartland and Old Talisman dungeon portals are 260 m south-east.

shots.notes: Two-shot: the twin Tumerok spire towers stand on their ridge. The lens is 95 m north-west, 71 m above the falling slope, at the towers' height, and drifts 8 deg with the afternoon sun behind it. Tower A sits left and tower B right of centre (ndc x -0.17 and +0.17), each filling the middle half of the frame height, with the Dires and the Obsidian Rim country beyond.
